briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Grok-4 escalate multi-agent race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with new reasoning models while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Funding remains robust but compute constraints and security vulnerabilities create bottlenecks. DialectForge protocol adoption signals industry shift toward protocol-level defenses.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 with 2.1T parameters focused on agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3.0 Pro launched last week. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B while DeepSeek-V3 set new efficiency benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins August 1 with new red-teaming mandates.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced 50k H100-equivalent cluster expansions. TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving to 72%. Energy demands push new nuclear SMR deals for data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems outpace safety alignment by Q4 2026?
